scripts._comment_fetch_enumerations: Pulls enumeration definitions for the tenant set in .env and emits per-enum TS modules under src/types/enumerations/ plus the master registry at src/types/enumerations.generated.ts. Entity and saved-query codegen consume the registry to type Enumeration fields as unions instead of `string`. Run BEFORE fetch:entities and fetch:saved-queries.
scripts._comment_fetch_entities: Pulls entity definitions for the tenant set in .env (PHOENIX_API_URL + TENANT_ID) and emits per-entity TS interfaces under src/types/entities/. Run on demand.
scripts._comment_fetch_saved_queries: Pulls saved-query definitions for the tenant set in .env and emits per-query TS modules (interfaces + executeXxx wrapper) under src/types/saved-queries/ plus the master registry at src/types/saved-queries.generated.ts. Saved queries are READ-ONLY; writes go through useEntityMutation.
scripts._comment_fetch_workflows: Pulls workflow definitions for the tenant set in .env and emits per-workflow TS modules (Input/Output interfaces + executeXxx wrapper) under src/types/workflows/ plus the master registry at src/types/workflows.generated.ts. Workflows have SIDE EFFECTS; use useWorkflow(name).mutate(input) on user action. V1 codegen surfaces sync workflows only; async are skipped with a console.log.
scripts._comment_fetch_partner_modules: Pulls partner-module + partner-category definitions for the tenant set in .env and emits per-module TS modules (Input/Output interfaces + executeXxx wrapper) under src/types/partner-modules/ plus the master registry at src/types/partner-modules.generated.ts. Partner modules invoke external systems (identity, notifications, risk, …) with SIDE EFFECTS; use usePartnerModule(name).mutate(input) on user action. Modules with a category are routed via /api/proxy/execute-partner-category/{category}/{name}; categoryless modules use /api/proxy/{name}/{variant}.
scripts._comment_fetch_application: Pulls the deployed app's metadata (label, description, app_definition_key, …) for the configured APP_NAME (or APP_ID) + TENANT_ID from /api/internal/applications?name={name} (array response; takes the first match) and emits src/types/app.md (agent reference) + src/types/app.generated.ts (typed APPLICATION const). DefaultLayout reads APPLICATION.label for the top-bar brand; the agent reads app.md before writing any page. PHX-3863.
scripts._comment_fetch_related_screens: Pulls every screen across the tenant in ONE call (component-definitions-all/screen) and emits the cross-app navigation catalog: src/types/related-screens.{catalog.md,generated.ts}. Lists OTHER related apps' pages + their nav.* deep-link variables so the agent can wire cross-app links without guessing screen names. Filter via RELATED_APP_KEYS; current app excluded via APP_NAME. See docs/CROSS-APP-NAVIGATION-PLAN.md.
scripts._comment_fetch_skills: Pulls every platform SKILL (agent) across the tenant in ONE call (component-definitions-all/skill-definition) and emits src/types/skills.{catalog.md,generated.ts}. Skills are the platform's agents; names/types come from the generated registry (SkillName, SKILLS, SKILLS_BY_NAME). Refreshed on every workspace cold-boot alongside saved-queries/workflows.
scripts._comment_fetch_tenant_refs: Pulls stable TENANT-wide reference data (roles, permission-groups, org hierarchy, org levels) for the tenant set in .env and emits typed snapshot consts + agent-facing catalogs under src/types/{roles,permission-groups,org,org-levels}.{generated.ts,catalog.md}. These don't change within a session, so they are snapshotted (not runtime-fetched). permission-groups + org/org_level require an X-Jiffy-App-Name header; the script always sends the tenant-wide `platform` lens, so no app env var is needed.
scripts._comment_branding_runtime: Tenant branding (logo / favicon / theme) is NOT code-generated. It is read at runtime by src/components/branding-provider.tsx via usePreferences() (/api/internal/preferences?is_merged=true); a null App.Theme falls back to the starter's DEFAULT_THEME (src/lib/default-theme.ts).
